actions.action: Check for roots coming out of drainage holes or circling root ball
Repot into 8-inch pot with chunky mix (soil plus perlite/orchid bark) in spring or summer
Move plant near brightest window for bright indirect light
Rotate plant a quarter turn weekly
Check top 2 inches of soil and water thoroughly when dry
Feed with half-strength balanced liquid fertilizer monthly in spring and summer
Optionally trim longest branches above a leaf node for bushiness
